## Overview

Decorative separator between options or groups; excluded from navigation. ARIA does not allow
`separator` inside a listbox, so it is hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden`).

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzListboxSeparator`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/listbox/listbox-group.directive.ts:40](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/listbox/listbox-group.directive.ts#L40)

## Selector

```text

```
